Learning goals · Installation of Python

Python Setup · Slide 1–2

Learning goals

  • Understand the different package management systems
  • Be comfortable in settig up a python environment

0. Installation of Python

Python can be installed in many ways, e.g. by

  • directly downloading it from python.org: https://www.python.org/downloads/
  • downloading Miniconda: https://docs.conda.io/en/latest/miniconda.html

翻译: 学习目标: 了解不同的包管理系统; 能熟练地搭好 Python 环境; 知道怎样让自己的工作可复现. 安装 Python 有多种方式: 直接从 python.org 下载, 装 Miniconda, 或者装 Anaconda 发行版.

原文笔误: 「settig up」应为 setting up. 另外这份课件每页页脚印的是「ML Basics – N / ??」, 总页数没有编译出来 (LaTeX 的引用没解析), 实际共 27 页.

Python 的两套包管理: pip 和 conda
Package management in Python

Python Setup · Slide 3–5

Unlike in R/RStudio (which you might be used to), package management in Python is a little more of a mess: There are two package management systems:

  • pip (+ PyPi)
  • conda (+ Anaconda repository)

pip

  • Installs packages from the Python Package Index (PyPi)
  • Pip packages are source distributions (compiler needed) or wheels1
  • Installs dependencies in a recursive, serial loop
  • Limited to Python software
  • No built-in support for virtual environments (but possible)
  • > 150k packages available on PyPi

1 tl;dr: wheels are smaller + install faster than a source distribution and do not require a compiler

conda

  • Installs packages from the Anaconda repository
  • Conda packages are binaries, no need for compilers
  • SAT solver to verify requirements of all packages
  • Not limited to Python software
  • Easier to create/manage virtual environments
  • ∼ 1.5k packages available in the Anaconda repository

翻译: 和 R/RStudio 不同, Python 的包管理有点乱: 有两套系统. pip 从 PyPI 装包; 包要么是源码包 (需要编译器), 要么是 wheel (预编译好的, 更小、装得更快、不需要编译器); 依赖按递归、串行的方式一个个装; 只能装 Python 软件; 本身不带虚拟环境 (但可以配合 venv 用); PyPI 上有超过 15 万个包. conda 从 Anaconda 仓库装包; 包都是二进制, 不需要编译器; 用 SAT 求解器检查所有包的版本要求能否同时满足; 不限于 Python 软件 (也能装 CUDA、C 库); 建虚拟环境更方便; 仓库里约 1500 个包.

根本区别: 两者的根本区别是依赖解析: conda 先整体求解所有约束再装, pip 按顺序装, 装到后面才可能发现版本冲突. 深度学习常见的做法是用 conda 建环境、装 Python 和 CUDA, 再用 pip 装 PyPI 上更新更全的包.

课件里的数字已经过时: PyPI 现在有 60 万以上的项目; conda 默认 (defaults) 频道约几千个包, 社区频道 conda-forge 有两万多个. 另外 pip 从 20.3 版 (2020) 起也有了完整的依赖解析器, 不再是简单的「串行安装」. 拼写上应是 PyPI (Python Package Index), 课件写成 PyPi.

在终端里用 Python
Python via the console

Python Setup · Slide 6

Start Python in Terminal / Console / Command Line

python

Approximate result: Similar to R console:

1+1

Exit with Ctrl-D or

exit ()

翻译: 在终端输入 python 启动交互式解释器, 用法和 R 控制台类似, 例如输入 1+1 得到 2. 用 Ctrl-D (Windows 上是 Ctrl-Z 加回车) 或 exit() 退出.

易错: 课件里 exit () 中间的空格是排版造成的, 写成 exit () 也能运行 (Python 允许函数名和括号之间有空格), 但习惯写法是 exit(). 在 macOS 和很多 Linux 上命令是 python3, 只有在激活的 conda/venv 环境里 python 才一定存在.

Anaconda、Miniconda 和编辑器
Anaconda · Miniconda · Spyder · Jupyter · VS Code · RStudio

Python Setup · Slide 7–14

2. Anaconda — Anaconda is a widely used open-source distribution of Python: https://www.anaconda.com

3. Miniconda — We recommend downloading and installing Miniconda, since it

  • directly brings conda (as well as pip)
  • is a minimal installer (only the core parts, unlike Anaconda)

(Bild: Anaconda = Baumarkt, Miniconda = Werkbank, Conda = Werkzeug. Source: https://www.mrdbourke.com/get-your-computer-ready-for-machine-learning-using-anaconda-miniconda-and-conda/)

4. Spyder — Spyder is a complete IDE for Python (very similar to RStudio)

  • directly comes with the Anaconda distribution
  • can also be installed from https://www.spyder-ide.org/

5. Jupyter Notebooks/Lab

  • web application that lets you develop Python code in your browser
  • combine code, text, images, and other media
  • execute your code in smaller parts (cells)
  • Useful for explorative analyses and for beginning stages of a project, where you need frequent feedback
conda install jupyterlab

Code cells vs. Markdown cells — Useful for creating and changing figures quickly

  • When you click into a cell and you see your cursor, then you are in Edit Mode
  • Write your Code/Explanations and execute with Ctrl+Enter
  • Hit Esc → Cursor disappears, cell is still selected (you are in Command mode now)
  • Now there are, among others, certain shortcuts available:
    • A will insert a new cell above the current one
    • B will insert one below
    • C copies the selected cell
    • X cuts the selected cell
    • V pastes copied/cut cell below
    • M switches the cell mode to Markdown
    • Y switches it to Code
    • Up selects cell above
    • Down selects cell below

6. Visual Studio Code

  • Widely used editor for many programming languages
  • Main advantage: supports Jupyter Notebooks, takes care of setting up server
  • install from https://code.visualstudio.com/

7. R-Studio — RStudio can also be used as an IDE for Python:

  • Install the reticulate packages in R
  • Select the desired Python interpreter at Tools > Global Options > Python
  • New File > Python Script

翻译: Anaconda 是常用的开源 Python 发行版, 预装了几百个科学计算包. 课程推荐 Miniconda: 它自带 conda 和 pip, 只装核心部分 (幻灯片的比喻: Anaconda 是整个五金店, Miniconda 是工作台, conda 是工具). Spyder 是类似 RStudio 的完整 Python IDE. Jupyter Notebook/Lab 是浏览器里的开发环境, 可以把代码、文字、图片混在一起, 按单元格分段执行, 适合探索性分析和项目初期需要频繁看结果的阶段 (练习单都是 .ipynb). 单元格分代码单元和 Markdown 单元. 光标在单元格里是编辑模式, Ctrl+Enter 执行; 按 Esc 进入命令模式, 这时 A/B 在上方/下方插入单元格, C 复制, X 剪切, V 粘贴到下方, M 改成 Markdown, Y 改成代码, 上下箭头选择单元格. VS Code 支持 Notebook 并自动启动 Jupyter 服务; RStudio 也能通过 R 包 reticulate 运行 Python.

易错: Ctrl+Enter 执行后光标留在原单元格; Shift+Enter 执行并跳到下一个单元格. Notebook 里单元格可以乱序执行, 交作业前要「Restart & Run All」确认从头到尾能跑通 (练习单的提交规定要求交「executed」的 notebook).

虚拟环境
Virtual environments

Python Setup · Slide 15–17

Assume the following scenario:

  • We have two ongoing projects, Project A and Project B
  • Both projects need some package pkg_xy
  • Project A needs v1.2.0 while Project B requires v2.1.3
  • What can we do about this?

Solution: Work with virtual environments

Virtual Environments allow you to

  • have different entire version of Python running on your machine (Python 2, Python 3.x, Python 3.y, ..)
  • maintain different versions of packages for your projects

They can be created/activated/deactivated via

conda create --name some_name python=3.9
conda activate some_name
conda deactivate some_name

Useful commands: Conda Cheat Sheet

Different versions of Python · Different (versions of) packages

(Terminal-Screenshots: in der Umgebung helloworld startet Python 3.8.3, in inhouse Python 3.6.5; in inhouse funktioniert import matplotlib, in helloworld bricht er mit ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'matplotlib' ab.)

翻译: 场景: 项目 A 和 B 都要用包 pkg_xy, 但 A 要 1.2.0 版, B 要 2.1.3 版, 一个 Python 安装里只能有一个版本. 解决办法是虚拟环境: 每个环境有自己的 Python 版本和自己的一套包. 用 conda create 新建, conda activate 激活, conda deactivate 退出. 截图演示: 激活 helloworld 后是 Python 3.8.3, 激活 inhouse 后是 Python 3.6.5; matplotlib 只装在 inhouse 里, 所以在 helloworld 里 import matplotlib 报 ModuleNotFoundError.

幻灯片错误: conda deactivate 不接环境名, 它总是退出当前激活的环境 (嵌套激活时回到上一层). 写成 conda deactivate some_name 不会得到想要的效果, 正确写法就是 conda deactivate. 另外 --name 和 python=3.9 在 PDF 里被排成「-- name」「python =3.9」, 带空格照抄会出错.

管理包和版本约束
Managing packages

Python Setup · Slide 18–19

With conda:

conda install pandas
conda install pandas==1.3.5
conda update pandas
conda remove pandas
conda list

With pip:

pip install pandas
pip install pandas==1.3.5
pip install pandas --upgrade
pip uninstall pandas
pip freeze

Instruct conda which version you want to have installed:

  • Exact (1.3.5) conda install pandas==1.3.5
  • Fuzzy (1.3.0, 1.3.1, etc.) conda install pandas==1.3
  • Greater or equal (1.3.5 or higher) conda install "pandas>=1.3.5"
  • OR (1.3.4 or 1.3.5) conda install "pandas==1.3.4|1.3.5"
  • AND (1.3.3, 1.3.4, but not 1.4) conda install "pandas>=1.3.3,<1.4"

翻译: conda 和 pip 的对应命令: 安装、装指定版本、升级、卸载、列出已装的包 (conda list / pip freeze). conda 的版本约束: 精确 ==1.3.5; 模糊 (1.3 系列任意版本); 大于等于; 或 (|); 与 (逗号).

引号: 带 > < | 的约束要加引号, 否则 shell 会把它们当成重定向或管道.

幻灯片错误: 「Fuzzy」那一行写的是 pandas==1.3. 在 conda 的匹配规则里, 双等号是精确匹配, ==1.3 只匹配版本号恰好是 1.3 (即 1.3.0) 的包; 模糊匹配要用单等号 pandas=1.3, 才会匹配 1.3.0、1.3.1 … 1.3.5 (等价于 1.3.*).

可复现性: environment.yml 和 requirements.txt
Reproducibility

Python Setup · Slide 20–27

Standardized way of sharing code requirements with others publicly across platforms:

  • environment.yml (conda)
  • requirements.txt (pip)

Create an environment:2 (with specific Python version and some packages)

conda create -n my_env python=3.7 pandas numpy scikit-learn

Activate the conda environment: conda activate my_env

Export the specifications of your conda environment:

conda env export > environment.yml

3 -n is the short version of the --name flag

Result (abbreviated to fit on the slide):

name: my_env
channels:
  - defaults
dependencies:
  - blas=1.0=mkl
  - bottleneck=1.3.2=py37h2a96729_1
  - ...
  - numpy=1.21.2=py37hfca59bb_0
  - numpy-base=1.21.2=py37h0829f74_0
  - openssl=1.1.1l=h2bbff1b_0
  - packaging=21.3=pyhd3eb1b0_0
  - pandas=1.3.4=py37h6214cd6_0
  - pip=21.2.4=py37haa95532_0
  - pyparsing=3.0.4=pyhd3eb1b0_0
  - python=3.7.11=h6244533_0
  - python-dateutil=2.8.2=pyhd3eb1b0_0
  - pytz=2021.3=pyhd3eb1b0_0
  - scikit-learn=1.0.1=py37hf11a4ad_0
  - scipy=1.7.1=py37hbe87c03_2
  - ...
prefix: C:\Users\ri85vex\Miniconda3\envs\my_env
  • Note 1: As you can see, this also includes all sorts of packages that are automatically installed when creating an environment
  • Note 2: We observe some cryptic stuff after the version of each package
  • Note 3: Those packages installed via pip are **also handled by this file** (see next slide)
  • Note 4: The prefix is ignored when using the .yml-file for creation. So you can simply delete it after the export.

Install some package via pip: pip install matplotlib — Result (abbreviated to fit on the slide):

name: my_env
channels:
  - defaults
dependencies:
  - blas=1.0=mkl
  - bottleneck=1.3.2=py37h2a96729_1
  - ca-certificates=2021.10.26=haa95532_2
  - certifi=2021.10.8=py37haa95532_0
  - icc_rt=2019.0.0=h0cc432a_1
  - intel-openmp=2021.4.0=haa95532_3556
  - ...
  - pip:
    - cycler==0.11.0
    - fonttools==4.28.5
    - kiwisolver==1.3.2
    - matplotlib==3.5.1
    - pillow==9.0.0
prefix: C:\Users\ri85vex\Miniconda3\envs\my_env

Using the “–from-history“ flag

conda env export --from-history > environment.yml

allows you to create a reduced version of the .yml-file containing only the packages (+ version) you explicitly installed (via conda):

name: my_env
channels:
  - defaults
dependencies:
  - scikit-learn
  - numpy
  - python=3.7
  - pandas
prefix: C:\Users\ri85vex\Miniconda3\envs\my_env

Export specifications of the pip packages: pip freeze > requirements.txt — Can be installed in a conda environment via: pip install -r requirements.txt

But: Requiring others to execute these two steps will create a lot of work!

Best practice: Create .yml-file manually

name: my_env
channels:
  - defaults
dependencies:
  - python=3.7.11
  - numpy=1.21.2
  - pandas=1.3.4
  - scikit-learn=1.0.1
  - pip=21.2.4
  - pip:
    # works for regular pip packages
    - matplotlib==2.0.0
    # also works for whole requirements-files:
    - -r requirements.txt

Finally: Create environment from .yml-file: conda env create -f environment.yml

翻译: 跨平台分享依赖的标准文件: conda 用 environment.yml, pip 用 requirements.txt. conda env export 导出的文件 (注 1) 包含所有自动装上的依赖包; (注 2) 每个版本号后面那串「py37h2a96729_1」是 build string, 标明为哪个 Python 版本、哪个平台编译的; (注 3) 用 pip 装的包也会写进文件, 列在 - pip: 下面; (注 4) 末尾的 prefix (环境在本机的路径) 用文件新建环境时会被忽略, 可以删掉. 加 --from-history 只导出你明确用 conda 装过的包 (不含版本号, 除非安装时指定了, 如 python=3.7; 也不含 pip 装的包). pip freeze > requirements.txt 导出 pip 包, 别人再用 pip install -r 安装; 但让别人分两步装很麻烦. 最佳做法: 手写 environment.yml, 只列直接依赖并固定版本, pip 包写在 pip: 下 (也可以引用整个 requirements 文件), 然后 conda env create -f environment.yml 一步建好环境.

为什么手写最好: 完整导出的文件带 build string, 而 build string 是平台相关的 (这里的 h2bbff1b、haa95532 是 Windows 版), 在 macOS/Linux 上往往解析不出来; 还包含 mkl、icc_rt、intel-openmp 这类只在 Windows/Intel 上存在的包. 手写的文件只列直接依赖, 跨平台也能求解.

幻灯片小错: ① Slide 21 正文里的脚注号是「2」, 页脚的脚注却编成「3」, 不一致. ② Slide 25 写「–from-history」, 用的是 en dash 和弯引号, 照抄会报错, 命令行参数必须是两个普通连字符 --from-history. ③ Note 3 里的 **also handled by this file** 是没渲染的 Markdown 加粗标记.

练习 2: PyTorch 的基本逻辑
Pytorch Logic对应 DPNLP I 02 · 深度学习基础;源文件 slides-01-pytorch.pdf (21 页);原标题副标题为「Exercise 3」

为什么用 PyTorch
Learning goals · Why PyTorch? · Enter PyTorch!

Pytorch Logic · Slide 1–4

Learning goals: Understand how a tensor works · Understand how backpropagation works · Be able to write basic PyTorch code

Why PyTorch? Can we implement neural networks with numpy? Sure we can, but...

  • ... we would have to implement many functionalities from scratch
  • ... we would have to derive all of our gradients by hand → error-prone and annoying
  • ... numpy has no inherent way of grouping functions and their parameters → no modularization
  • ... numpy does not support calculations on GPU

Enter PyTorch!

  • Open source library for deep learning with Python, developed by Facebook
  • Documentation: http://pytorch.org/docs/master/torch.html
  • 60 minute tutorial: https://pytorch.org/tutorials/beginner/deep_learning_60min_blitz.html

PyTorch

  • ... has many pre-implemented layers, loss functions and optimizers
  • ... can do gradients and backpropagation automatically
  • ... has object-oriented grouping of functions and parameters into modules
  • ... supports calculations on GPU

翻译: 学习目标: 理解张量 (tensor) 怎么工作; 理解反向传播怎么工作; 会写基本的 PyTorch 代码. 用 numpy 也能实现神经网络, 但要从头实现很多功能; 所有梯度都要手推, 容易出错; numpy 没有把函数和参数打包的机制, 无法模块化; numpy 不能在 GPU 上算. PyTorch 是 Facebook 开发的开源深度学习库, 正好补上这四点: 预置大量层、损失函数和优化器; 自动求梯度和反向传播; 用面向对象的模块 (module) 组织函数和参数; 支持 GPU.

PyTorch 从 2022 年起归属 Linux 基金会下的 PyTorch Foundation, 不再由 Meta (Facebook) 单独管理. 文档地址现在是 https://pytorch.org/docs/stable/ (master 版对应开发中的版本).

张量与创建张量
Tensors · Creating tensors

Pytorch Logic · Slide 5–7
  • torch.tensor: Numerical objects (scalars, vectors, matrices...)
  • Every tensor has a data type (dtype) and a shape (which is called size)
  • Tensors can be manipulated and combined via operations (addition, matrix multiplication, concatenation, etc.)
  • The result of a tensor operation is a new tensor
  • Think about torch.tensor as the pytorch equivalent of numpy.array (but with some additional abilities related to gradients)
>>> import torch
>>> # You can create tensors from nested Python lists:
>>> torch.tensor([[1.0, 1.3], [7.7, 8.0]], dtype=torch.float32)
tensor([[1.0000, 1.3000],
        [7.7000, 8.0000]])
>>> # ... or from numpy arrays:
>>> torch.from_numpy(np.arange(3))
tensor([0, 1, 2])
>>> # ... or from all-zeros / all-ones:
>>> torch.ones(size=(2,3))
>>> torch.zeros(size=(2,3))
>>> # ... or through random initialization:
>>> y = torch.rand(size=(2,), dtype=torch.float32)
>>> # You can easily convert tensors back to numpy arrays:
>>> y.detach().numpy()
array([0.5634323, 0.8529429], dtype=float32)

Operations often work similar to numpy (with some exceptions):

>>> vector = torch.tensor([1.0, 1.3])
>>> vector2 = torch.tensor([-.5, -.7])
>>> matrix = torch.ones(size=(2,3))
>>> # elementwise addition, subtraction, multiplication..
>>> vector + vector2
>>> vector * vector2
>>> # elementwise unary functions (log, exp, etc.)
>>> torch.log(vector)
>>> torch.exp(vector)
>>> # dot product
>>> vector.dot(vector2)
>>> # matrix multiplication
>>> vector.matmul(matrix)

翻译: torch.tensor 是数值对象 (标量、向量、矩阵……), 每个张量有数据类型 dtype 和形状 (PyTorch 里叫 size); 张量可以做加法、矩阵乘法、拼接等运算, 结果是新张量. 可以把它看成 numpy.array 的 PyTorch 版, 只是多了和梯度有关的能力. 创建方式: 从嵌套列表、从 numpy 数组、全 0/全 1、随机初始化; .detach().numpy() 转回 numpy (先 detach 是因为带梯度的张量不能直接转). 运算和 numpy 类似.

Slide 7 的运算我实际运行了一遍 (幻灯片没印输出):

>>> vector + vector2
tensor([0.5000, 0.6000])
>>> vector * vector2
tensor([-0.5000, -0.9100])
>>> torch.log(vector)
tensor([0.0000, 0.2624])
>>> torch.exp(vector)
tensor([2.7183, 3.6693])
>>> vector.dot(vector2)
tensor(-1.4100)
>>> vector.matmul(matrix)
tensor([2.3000, 2.3000, 2.3000])

vector.dot(vector2) = 1·(−0.5) + 1.3·(−0.7) = −1.41; vector.matmul(matrix) 是 (2,) 乘 (2,3), 每一列都是 1 + 1.3 = 2.3.

易错: torch.from_numpy 和原数组共享内存, 改一个另一个也变; torch.tensor(arr) 则会复制. Slide 6 用到 np, 前面要先 import numpy as np. torch.rand 的结果每次不同, 所以 array([0.5634323, 0.8529429]) 只是一次运行的例子.

自动求导
Automatic differentiation

Pytorch Logic · Slide 8

y^​=xTw∇w​y^​=x;∇x​y^​=w

  • When we apply operations to tensors, pytorch implicitly builds a computation graph
  • When backpropagation is invoked at a scalar tensor, the gradients of that tensor are computed via automatic differentiation
  • The gradients are stored in the grad attribute of the input tensors:
>>> x = torch.tensor([1., 2., 3.], requires_grad=True)
>>> w = torch.tensor([0., 0., 1.], requires_grad=True)
>>> y_hat = x.dot(w)
>>> y_hat
tensor(3., grad_fn=<DotBackward0>)
>>> y_hat.backward()
>>> (w.grad, x.grad)
(tensor([1., 2., 3.]), tensor([0., 0., 1.]))

翻译: 对张量做运算时, PyTorch 在后台记录一张计算图; 在一个标量张量上调用 backward(), 就用自动微分算出它对各输入的梯度, 存在输入张量的 .grad 属性里.

验算: y^​=1⋅0+2⋅0+3⋅1=3. 点积对 w 的梯度是 x = [1, 2, 3], 对 x 的梯度是 w = [0, 0, 1], 和输出一致. 记住「对谁求导, 结果就是另一个」.

版本差异: 幻灯片印的是 grad_fn=<DotBackward>; 新版 PyTorch (1.10 起) 的名字带编号, 我用 2.14 实际运行得到 <DotBackward0>, 上面已按实际运行结果改正. 后面的 AddmmBackward、MseLossBackward 同理, 现在是 AddmmBackward0、MseLossBackward0.

关闭自动求导
Disabling automatic differentiation

Pytorch Logic · Slide 9
  • Automatic differentiation is expensive:
    • We have to store the content of all intermediate tensors
    • After backpropagation, we have to store the gradients
  • Disabling automatic differentiation:
    • Use requires_grad=False for tensors that do not require gradients (e.g., “frozen” parameters)
    • When you don’t intend to do gradient updates (e.g., during evaluation), use torch.no_grad() context
>>> x = torch.tensor([1., 2., 3.], requires_grad=False)
>>> w = torch.tensor([0., 0., 1.], requires_grad=True)
>>> with torch.no_grad():
...   y_hat = x.dot(w)
...   y_hat.backward() # no_grad context -> no backpropagation
RuntimeError: element 0 of tensors does not require grad and does not have a grad_fn
>>> y_hat = x.dot(w)
>>> y_hat.backward()
>>> (w.grad, x.grad) # gradients only for tensors with requires_grad=True
(tensor([1., 2., 3.]), None)

翻译: 自动求导代价高: 要保存所有中间张量, 反向传播后还要保存梯度. 关闭方式: 不需要梯度的张量 (如冻结的参数) 设 requires_grad=False; 不打算更新参数时 (如评估) 用 torch.no_grad() 上下文. 在 no_grad 里算出的 y_hat 没有计算图, 对它 backward 会报 RuntimeError. 在外面重新算一次再 backward, 只有 requires_grad=True 的 w 得到梯度 (= x), x.grad 是 None.

易错: 评估时忘了 torch.no_grad() 不会报错, 但会白白占用显存 (保存了整张计算图). model.eval() 只切换 Dropout/BatchNorm 的行为, 不会关掉梯度, 两者要一起用.

幻灯片小错: ① with 块里的续行提示符应是 ..., 幻灯片写成了 >>>; ② 只印了「RuntimeError」, 实际信息是 element 0 of tensors does not require grad and does not have a grad_fn; ③ 最后一行输出印成 (torch.tensor([1., 2., 3.]), None), 实际的 repr 是 (tensor([1., 2., 3.]), None). 上面已按实际运行结果改正.

用链式法则自动求导: 前馈网络
Automatic differentiation via chain rule: feed-forward net

Pytorch Logic · Slide 10–11 
>>> x = torch.tensor([1., 2., 3.], requires_grad=False) # inputs
>>> y = torch.tensor([.7, .8], requires_grad=False) # targets
>>> W = torch.rand(size=(3,2), requires_grad=True) # param 1
>>> V = torch.rand(size=(2,2), requires_grad=True) # param 2
>>> g = x.matmul(W) # hidden vector
>>> h = torch.relu(g) # hidden vector after nonlinearity
>>> y_hat = h.matmul(V) # predicted vector
>>> J = torch.mean((y_hat - y)**2) # MSE loss
>>> J.backward()
>>> W.grad
tensor([[2.1843, 1.4898],
        [4.3687, 2.9796],
        [6.5530, 4.4694]])
>>> V.grad
tensor([[3.7324, 4.8193],
        [7.0224, 9.0673]])
  • No matter how complicated our neural network becomes: As long as every function is a (differentiable) pytorch function, pytorch can derive the gradients via the chain rule.
  • No more manual backpropagation!

翻译: 两层网络: 隐藏层 g=Wx, ReLU 得到 h, 输出 y^​=Vh, 损失是均方误差 J=M1​∑i=1M​(y^​i​−yi​)2. 调用 J.backward() 后 W.grad、V.grad 自动算好. 无论网络多复杂, 只要每一步都是可微的 PyTorch 函数, 就能用链式法则求出梯度, 不用再手推反向传播.

为什么梯度是这个形状: 代码写的是 x.matmul(W), 即 g=x⊤W (W 是 3×2), 图里写成 Wx 只是记号不同. 由链式法则, ∂J/∂y^​=M2​(y^​−y) (这里 M = 2, 系数正好是 1); ∂J/∂V=h(∂J/∂y^​)⊤ 是外积, 所以 V.grad 的两行互成比例 (3.7324 : 7.0224 = 4.8193 : 9.0673 ≈ 0.53); 同理 ∂J/∂W=xδ⊤, δ 是传回隐藏层的误差, 所以 W.grad 三行正好是 1 : 2 : 3 倍 (2.1843, 4.3687, 6.5530), 因为 x = [1, 2, 3]. 这两点可以用来检查幻灯片的数字: 都对得上.

易错: W、V 是随机初始化的, 没有设种子, 所以你运行时的数值和幻灯片不同, 只有上面说的比例关系不变.

模块、参数和 forward
Modules · Parameters · Forward function

Pytorch Logic · Slide 12–15
  • Pytorch groups functions and their parameters into modules (also called layers)
  • torch.nn contains many predefined module classes:
>>> import torch.nn as nn
>>> nn.Linear(in_features, out_features) # simple linear layer
>>> nn.Conv2d(in_channels, out_channels, kernel_size) # 2D CNN
>>> nn.Embedding(num_embeddings, embedding_dim) # lookup layer
>>> # and many more

Here, we instantiate a linear layer with input size 3 and output size 2:

>>> torch.random.manual_seed(0)
>>> linear = nn.Linear(in_features=3, out_features=2, bias=True)
  • Most modules have parameters
  • For example, our linear layer has a parameter matrix and a bias vector
  • The parameters are randomly initialized when the module is created
  • We can inspect the parameters:
>>> list(linear.parameters())
[Parameter containing:
tensor([[-0.0043,  0.3097, -0.4752],
        [-0.4249, -0.2224,  0.1548]], requires_grad=True), Parameter containing:
tensor([-0.0114,  0.4578], requires_grad=True)]

Note that requires_grad is set to True, because pytorch expects us to train these parameters.

Every module class has a forward function, which handles the forward-pass logic. In the case of the linear layer, the forward-pass logic is simply: f(x)=Wx+b

class Linear(Module):
    # (...)
    def forward(self, input: Tensor) -> Tensor:
        return F.linear(input, self.weight, self.bias)

# F.linear:
def linear(input, weight, bias=None):
    # (...)
    output = input.matmul(weight.t())
    if bias is not None:
        output += bias
    ret = output
    return ret

“Calling” a module means calling its forward function:

>>> inputs = torch.tensor([[1., 2., 3.], [4., 5., 6.]])
>>> predictions = linear(inputs)
>>> predictions
tensor([[-0.8219,  0.0526],
        [-1.3313, -1.4247]], grad_fn=<AddmmBackward0>)
>>> linear.forward(inputs) # this is equivalent
tensor([[-0.8219,  0.0526],
        [-1.3313, -1.4247]], grad_fn=<AddmmBackward0>)

Typically, modules expect their inputs to have a batch axis. So in reality, the input is a tensor of shape (N, . . .), where N is the number of datapoints per batch (here: 2), and . . . stands for the remaining axes (here: one 3-dimensional feature axis). The layer is then applied to every datapoint independently.

翻译: PyTorch 把函数和它的参数打包成模块 (也叫层); torch.nn 里有现成的线性层、二维卷积、嵌入查找层等. nn.Linear(3, 2) 有一个 2×3 的权重矩阵和长度 2 的偏置, 创建时随机初始化, requires_grad=True 表示它们要被训练. 每个模块类都有 forward 函数定义前向计算; 线性层就是 f(x)=Wx+b, 源码里写成 input.matmul(weight.t()) 再加偏置, 因为输入的每一行是一个数据点. 「调用」模块 linear(inputs) 就是调用 forward. 模块默认输入第 0 维是批维度 (N, …), 对每个数据点独立计算.

我用 torch.random.manual_seed(0) 实际运行, 参数和预测值与幻灯片逐位相同. 手算第一行第一列: −0.0043⋅1+0.3097⋅2−0.4752⋅3−0.0114=−0.8219. ✓

易错: 应该写 linear(inputs) 而不是 linear.forward(inputs): 前者经过 __call__, 会执行注册的 hook; 两者结果相同, 但习惯上不直接调 forward.

幻灯片小错: Slide 14 的代码缩进被排版打乱了 (def forward 和 class Linear 对齐、if 和函数体对齐), 照抄会 IndentationError; 上面已按 PyTorch 源码的结构恢复缩进. grad_fn 名称的版本差异见上一张卡片.

损失函数与反向传播
Loss functions · Backpropagation

Pytorch Logic · Slide 16–17

Many popular loss functions are pre-implemented in torch.nn:

>>> nn.MSELoss() # mean squared error
>>> nn.BCELoss() # Negative Log Likelihood (binary)
>>> nn.NLLLoss() # Negative Log Likelihood (multi-class)
>>> # and many more

A loss function behaves like a module, except that it has no parameters, and its forward function usually takes two inputs (the prediction and the target):

>>> loss_function = nn.MSELoss()
>>> targets = torch.tensor([[.1, .2], [-.3, -.4]])
>>> predictions = linear(inputs)
>>> predictions
tensor([[-0.8219,  0.0526],
        [-1.3313, -1.4247]], grad_fn=<AddmmBackward0>)
>>> loss = loss_function(predictions, targets)
>>> loss
tensor(0.7463, grad_fn=<MseLossBackward0>)

Now we can backpropagate the loss: >>> loss.backward()

Let’s look at the gradients of the loss w.r.t. the parameters. There is one gradient tensor per parameter (one for the matrix and one for the bias). These gradients were calculated when we called loss.backward(), and they are stored in the grad attribute:

>>> [param.grad for param in linear.parameters()]
[tensor([[-2.5235, -3.5000, -4.4766],
        [-2.1231, -2.7092, -3.2953]]), tensor([-0.9766, -0.5861])]

翻译: torch.nn 预置了常用损失: 均方误差 MSELoss, 二分类的 BCELoss, 多分类的 NLLLoss 等. 损失函数和模块用法一样, 只是没有参数, forward 通常接收预测和目标两个输入. 算出 loss 后 loss.backward(), 每个参数 (权重矩阵、偏置) 都得到一个同形状的梯度张量.

验算 (实际运行结果与幻灯片相同): MSE = 4 个元素误差平方的平均 = 4(−0.9219)2+(−0.1474)2+(−1.0313)2+(−1.0247)2​=0.7463. 偏置梯度是每列误差之和乘 2/4: 第 1 列 42​(−0.9219−1.0313)=−0.9766. ✓

易错: BCELoss 要求输入已经是概率 (先过 sigmoid), NLLLoss 要求输入是 log 概率 (先过 log_softmax). 直接接网络输出的 logits 时应该用 BCEWithLogitsLoss 和 CrossEntropyLoss (= log_softmax + NLLLoss), 数值更稳定. 练习单 Exercise 01 用的就是 CrossEntropyLoss.

梯度更新与优化器
Gradient update · Optimizers

Pytorch Logic · Slide 18–20

Now that we have the gradients, we could update the parameters manually:

>>> learning_rate = 0.01
>>> with torch.no_grad():
...   for param in linear.parameters():
...     param.sub_(learning_rate*param.grad)

But that’s too much work. Instead, we use an optimizer from the torch.optim package

Optimizers are objects that take care of gradient updates. When instantiating an optimizer, you pass the model parameters to it. That way, the optimizer knows what it has to update:

>>> import torch.optim as optim
>>> optimizer = optim.SGD(linear.parameters(), lr=0.01)
  • Pytorch has many complex pre-implemented optimizers
  • Complex optimizers can do things like adapt the momentum of the learning rate, use different learning rates for different parameters, etc.
>>> optim.Adam(linear.parameters(), lr=0.01)
>>> optim.RMSprop(linear.parameters(), lr=0.01)
>>> # ...and many more. Let's use SGD for now.

With an optimizer, the gradient update step is simply:

>>> optimizer.step() # update all parameters with their gradients
>>> optimizer.zero_grad() # zero out all gradients
  • Careful: The call to optimizer.zero_grad() is easy to forget. But it is important.
    • If we don’t zero out gradients, they sum up inside the grad tensor. As a result, the “gradient” at training step 1000 would be ∑i=11000​∇θ​J(θ;xi​,yi​) instead of ∇θ​J(θ;x1000​,y1000​) (where xi​,yi​ is the i’th training batch)

翻译: 有了梯度可以手动更新: 在 no_grad 里对每个参数做 θ←θ−η∇θ​J (sub_ 是原地减). 更方便的是 torch.optim 里的优化器: 创建时把模型参数传进去; optimizer.step() 用梯度更新所有参数, optimizer.zero_grad() 把梯度清零. 复杂的优化器 (Adam、RMSprop) 会自适应地调整每个参数的步长、使用动量等. zero_grad() 很容易忘: PyTorch 的梯度是累加的, 不清零的话第 1000 步用的「梯度」其实是前 1000 个批次梯度之和.

标准训练循环的顺序: optimizer.zero_grad() → 前向 → loss.backward() → optimizer.step(). 梯度累加有时是故意的: Exercise 03 的 gradient_accumulation_steps=2 就是先累加两个小批次再更新一次, 模拟双倍批大小.

幻灯片小错: 「adapt the momentum of the learning rate」说法不准确: 动量 (momentum) 作用在梯度上 (对历史梯度做指数平均), 不是学习率的属性; Adam、RMSprop 的「自适应」是指按每个参数梯度平方的滑动平均调整有效步长.

在 GPU 上用 PyTorch
Using PyTorch on a GPU

Pytorch Logic · Slide 21

First, check if CUDA is available on your machine:

>>> torch.cuda.is_available()
True

Then, move your model (your nn.module object) to the GPU.

>>> model = model.to(device='cuda')

If you have several GPUs, you can select them by their index:

>>> model = model.to(device='cuda:2') # indices start at 0

Inputs have to be on the same device as the model:

>>> inputs = inputs.to(device='cuda') # or whatever device the model is on
>>> predictions = model(inputs)

Tensors that were computed by your model (here: predictions) live on the same device as the model. To move them back to the CPU:

>>> predictions.to(device='cpu')

翻译: 先用 torch.cuda.is_available() 检查有没有 CUDA; 再用 .to('cuda') 把模型搬到 GPU, 多块 GPU 时用 'cuda:2' 指定第 3 块 (从 0 编号). 输入必须和模型在同一个设备上; 模型算出来的张量也在那个设备上, 用 .to('cpu') 搬回来.

易错: 对模块 model.to(...) 是原地搬移 (返回的是同一个对象), 对张量 inputs.to(...) 返回新张量, 必须赋值回去, 只写 inputs.to('cuda') 不会改变 inputs. 常见报错「Expected all tensors to be on the same device」就是漏了这一步. Apple 芯片的 Mac 上 GPU 设备叫 'mps', 用 torch.backends.mps.is_available() 检查.

import os
import sys
import random
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
from tqdm import tqdm
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.metrics import f1_score

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import torch.optim as optim
from torch.utils.data import Sampler, BatchSampler, Dataset, DataLoader
from torch.nn.utils.rnn import pad_sequence, pack_padded_sequence, pad_packed_sequence

from datasets import load_dataset
def regularized_f1(train_f1, dev_f1, threshold=0.0015):
    """
    Returns development F1 if overfitting is below threshold, otherwise 0.
    """
    return dev_f1 if (train_f1 - dev_f1) < threshold else 0


def save_metrics(*args, path, fname):
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        os.makedirs(path)
    if not os.path.isfile(path + fname):
        with open(path + fname, "w", newline="\n") as f:
            f.write(
                ",".join(
                    [
                        "config",
                        "epoch",
                        "train_loss",
                        "train_acc",
                        "train_f1",
                        "val_loss",
                        "val_acc",
                        "val_f1",
                    ]
                )
            )
            f.write("\n")
    if args:
        with open(path + fname, "a", newline="\n") as f:
            f.write(",".join([str(arg) for arg in args]))
            f.write("\n")

def seed_everything(seed: int):
    random.seed(seed)
    os.environ["PYTHONHASHSEED"] = str(seed)
    np.random.seed(seed)
    torch.manual_seed(seed)
    torch.cuda.manual_seed(seed)
    torch.backends.cudnn.deterministic = True
    torch.backends.cudnn.benchmark = True


seed_everything(1234)
VOCAB_SIZE = 20_000
BATCH_SIZE = 32
NUM_EPOCHS = 15
MAX_LEN = 256
LEARNING_RATE = 1e-4

翻译: 总提示: 看清下面的 import, 只用这些模块 (及其子模块), 不要再导入别的 (比如 PyTorch Lightning); 建议按提供的环境文件安装包; 每做完一小步就测试 (形状不对、数值离谱、NaN……), 但最终提交要保持原文件的格式. 提交规定: 代码要能在环境文件的版本上运行; 不要增删或改名 import; 删掉自己的测试代码; 不要改类名、函数名 (会用自动测试检查); 另外把 notebook 导出成 .py, 两个文件都交 (执行过、带图的 .ipynb 和 .py); 违反规定会扣分. 这几条在后面每张练习单开头都重复出现, 以后不再翻译.

给定的代码: regularized_f1 在「训练 F1 − 验证 F1 < 0.0015」(几乎没有过拟合) 时返回验证 F1, 否则返回 0; save_metrics 第一次调用时写表头, 之后每次追加一行; seed_everything 固定所有随机种子. 超参数: 词表 2 万, 批大小 32, 15 个 epoch, 序列最长 256 个词元, 学习率 1e-4.

题目小错: seed_everything 里先设 cudnn.deterministic = True, 又设 cudnn.benchmark = True. benchmark 模式会针对输入形状自动挑选最快的卷积/RNN 算法, 不同运行可能挑到不同算法, 正好破坏了可复现性; 要可复现应设 benchmark = False.

    # TODO

vocab = # TODO

翻译: 用 spacy.load() 加载 spaCy 的 en_core_web_sm, 命名为 nlp, 作为分词器. 遍历训练数据的 'text' 列, 对每条样本分词, 建立词表: 两个特殊词元 '<UNK>' 在下标 0, '<PAD>' 在下标 1; 词表大小限制为 VOCAB_SIZE; 写成可调用的 Vocab 类, 把词元映射到下标, 未知词一律映射到 0. 提示: 用 collections.Counter 统计词频, 只保留最常见的 VOCAB_SIZE - 2 个 (给两个特殊词元留位置); vocab[token] 查单个词, vocab(tokens) 查一串; 最好自己测一下未知词是否返回 0.

思路: Counter.most_common(n) 按频率降序返回前 n 个. 类里存一张列表 itos (下标 → 词) 和一个字典 stoi (词 → 下标); __getitem__ 用 dict.get(token, 0), __call__ 对列表逐个查. 分词只需要 spaCy 的分词器 nlp.tokenizer, 不需要跑词性标注等整条流水线 (快几十倍).

答案 (先自己做再看) 
import spacy                         # 题目的 import 里没有 spacy, 但要求用 spacy.load
from collections import Counter

nlp = spacy.load("en_core_web_sm")
def tokenizer(text):
    return [tok.text for tok in nlp.tokenizer(text.replace("<br />", " "))]

train_tok = [tokenizer(t) for t in train_data["text"]]
counter = Counter(tok for toks in train_tok for tok in toks)

class Vocab:
    def __init__(self, counter, max_size, specials=("<UNK>", "<PAD>")):
        self.itos = list(specials) + [tok for tok, _ in counter.most_common(max_size - len(specials))]
        self.stoi = {tok: i for i, tok in enumerate(self.itos)}
    def __getitem__(self, token):
        return self.stoi.get(token, 0)          # unknown -> <UNK> = 0
    def __call__(self, tokens):
        return [self[tok] for tok in tokens]
    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.itos)

vocab = Vocab(counter, VOCAB_SIZE)
print("vocab:", len(vocab), vocab["<UNK>"], vocab["<PAD>"], vocab["the"], vocab["qwertzuiop"], vocab(["a", "movie", "qwertzuiop"]))
vocab: 20000 0 1 2 0 [5, 21, 0]

词表正好 20 000 个; 「the」最常见, 排在两个特殊词元之后的下标 2; 造出来的词返回 0. 我在分词前把 HTML 换行标记 <br /> 换成空格: IMDB 的评论里到处是这个标记, spaCy 会把它和相邻的词粘成 'it.<br'、'/>Great' 这样的怪词元, 既浪费词表名额又把正常词变成 UNK. 题目没要求这一步, 不做也能得分, 但做了更干净.

易错: 词表只能用训练集建, 不能把验证集、测试集的词也数进去, 否则就是数据泄漏. 题目的 import 单元里没有 spacy 和 Counter, 但题目又要求用它们; 这和「不要增加 import」的规定矛盾, 只能在本单元里导入.

按长度分组的采样器
GroupedSampler

Exercise 01 · Task 1 (Sampler)
  • Having batches in which samples have a similar length, and thus less padding variations, improves training results
  • A GroupedSampler allows us to create a sampler with which we can customize the data loading process
  • It can then be implemented into the DataLoader, which automates loading data in multiple processes
  • Write a sampler which allows us to group together samples of similar length into a batch
    • The GroupedSampler takes as input the tokenized sequences from ImdbDataset, as well as the batch size
    • First, in the __init__ method, pair each sequence index with its tokenized sequence length
      • The result should be a list of tuples: [(index, tokenized_sequence_length), ...]
    • In the __iter__ method, we now:
      • Shuffle the list
      • generate groups of size BATCH_SIZE * 100
      • Each group of size BATCH_SIZE * 100 should be sorted in itself by the sequence length we calculated above
        • Sorting within each group is important because sorting based on the whole dataset would eliminate all training input variations
        • By shuffling in the __iter__ method, we shuffle the set of indices in each new iteration (which equals an epoch), therefore, we keep input variation
      • The result should be a list of tuples sorted by ascending sequence length: [(index, tokenized_sequence_length), ...]
      • After each BATCH_SIZE * 100 number of tuples, the sequence length of samples should drop and increase again
      • Example: 
        Sample index 3199: (1234, 256)
Sample index 3200: (567, 32)
Sample index 3201: (890, 33)
      • Filter the created and sorted list to only consist of indices. Make sure to keep the sorting!
      • Return this list as an iterator
    • Complete the __len__ method
class GroupedSampler(Sampler):
    def __init__(self, seqs, batch_size):
        # TODO

    def __iter__(self):
        # TODO
        return # TODO

    def __len__(self):
        return # TODO
  • Now create the GroupedSampler, use it as input to create a BatchSampler (imported in the beginning)
train_grouped_sampler = # TODO
train_sampler = # TODO

翻译: 一个批次里的样本长度相近 (补齐的量差别小), 训练效果更好. 写一个 GroupedSampler, 把长度相近的样本放进同一批. 输入是 ImdbDataset 里的下标序列和批大小. __init__: 把每个样本的序号和它的序列长度配成二元组 [(index, length), …]. __iter__: 先打乱列表; 切成大小为 BATCH_SIZE * 100 的组; 每组组内按长度升序排序 (只组内排: 整个数据集一起排就失去了输入的随机性; 每个 epoch 重新调用 __iter__ 都会重新打乱, 保持随机性). 结果是按长度排好的二元组列表, 每过 BATCH_SIZE * 100 个长度就跌回去重新上升 (例子: 第 3199 个是 256, 第 3200 个跌到 32). 最后只保留序号 (顺序不变), 返回迭代器. 补全 __len__. 然后用它构造 BatchSampler.

思路: 组大小 32 × 100 = 3200; sorted(group, key=lambda x: x[1]); BatchSampler(sampler, batch_size, drop_last=False) 会把采样器给出的序号流按顺序每 32 个切成一批, 所以组内排好序后, 每批里的样本长度自然相近.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
class GroupedSampler(Sampler):
    def __init__(self, seqs, batch_size):
        self.idx_len = [(i, len(s)) for i, s in enumerate(seqs)]
        self.batch_size = batch_size

    def __iter__(self):
        pairs = self.idx_len[:]                      # copy, keep the original untouched
        random.shuffle(pairs)
        size = self.batch_size * 100
        groups = [sorted(pairs[i:i + size], key=lambda x: x[1]) for i in range(0, len(pairs), size)]
        return iter([i for g in groups for i, _ in g])

    def __len__(self):
        return len(self.idx_len)

train_grouped_sampler = GroupedSampler(train_set.seq, BATCH_SIZE)
train_sampler = BatchSampler(train_grouped_sampler, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, drop_last=False)

order = list(iter(train_grouped_sampler))
print("sampler check:", [(i, order[i], len(train_set.seq[order[i]])) for i in (3198, 3199, 3200, 3201)])
sampler check: [(3198, 10948, 256), (3199, 7406, 256), (3200, 10218, 31), (3201, 9819, 33)]

和题目给的例子一样: 第一组的最后两个是被截断到 256 的长评论, 第 3200 个 (第二组的开头) 长度跌回 31. 每组 3200 = 100 个批次, 组内的批次长度从短到长递增.

易错: 直接 random.shuffle(self.idx_len) 也能用, 但会改动实例的属性; 拷一份更干净. __len__ 返回的是样本数 (18 750), 批数 586 由 BatchSampler 自己算 (⌈18750/32⌉ = 586).

翻译: 写 collate 函数, 接收 BatchSampler 给出的一批 (下标序列, 标签). 它要: 把序列补齐到同一长度, 补齐值用 1 (0 留给 UNK); 把标签变成张量; 再生成一个张量, 记录每条序列补齐前的长度; 返回三个张量: 序列、标签、长度. 然后建训练集的 DataLoader (worker 数随意, 提交时最多 2); 验证集和测试集也各建 Dataset 和 DataLoader, 不打乱、不用采样器, 但批大小和 collate 函数要一致.

思路: pad_sequence(list_of_tensors, batch_first=True, padding_value=1). 用了 batch_sampler 时 DataLoader 不能再给 batch_size、shuffle 参数 (会报错).

答案 (先自己做再看) 
def collate_batch(batch):
    seqs = [torch.tensor(s, dtype=torch.long) for s, _ in batch]
    labels = torch.tensor([l for _, l in batch], dtype=torch.long)
    lengths = torch.tensor([len(s) for s in seqs], dtype=torch.long)
    seqs = pad_sequence(seqs, batch_first=True, padding_value=1)
    return seqs, labels, lengths

train_loader = DataLoader(train_set, batch_sampler=train_sampler, collate_fn=collate_batch, num_workers=0)

test_loader = DataLoader(test_set, batch_size=BATCH_SIZE, shuffle=False, collate_fn=collate_batch)

任务 2: 搭建 BiLSTM
Task 2 – Build Your Model

Exercise 01 · Task 2

Task 2 - Build Your Model

The model should consist of: - an embedding layer, which takes vocab_size and embedding_dim as parameters - a dropout layer, which takes dropout as a parameter - an LSTM layer, which takes embedding_dim and rnn_size as parameters, and is bidirectional - a linear layer, which takes the dimension of rnn output as input dimension and returns an output of hidden_size dimensions - a linear layer, which first takes the previous layers output as input and returns one prediction per class of the dataset - the output of the BiLSTM has hidden representation tensors for each index of each sequence. However, for the task of sequence classification, we just need one hidden representation tensor per sequence. Use torch.mean() as a pooling function for dimensionality reduction. - use dropout on the embeddings and appropriate linear layer - use ReLU as the activation function on the appropriate linear layer

Hints: - keep the position of the batch dimension equal across all layers - use pack_padded_sequence and pad_packed_sequence at the appropriate steps. For more information, check out this answer on stackoverflow - remember to include the padding_idx=1 at relevant positions - as this is a binary classification task, it is possible to have 1 or 2 output neurons. Use your preference, but adjust the loss function towards your choice

class BiLSTM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_size, embedding_dim, rnn_size, hidden_size, dropout):
        super().__init__()

        # TODO


    def forward(self, seq, lengths):
        # TODO

翻译: 模型由这些部分组成: 嵌入层 (参数 vocab_size、embedding_dim); dropout 层 (参数 dropout); 双向 LSTM 层 (参数 embedding_dim、rnn_size); 一个线性层, 输入维度是 RNN 输出的维度, 输出 hidden_size 维; 再一个线性层, 把上一层的输出映射到每个类别一个分数. BiLSTM 对序列的每个位置都输出一个隐藏表示, 但序列分类只需要每条序列一个表示, 用 torch.mean() 做池化降维. 在嵌入和合适的那个线性层上用 dropout; 在合适的线性层上用 ReLU. 提示: 各层的批维度位置保持一致; 在合适的地方用 pack_padded_sequence 和 pad_packed_sequence; 在相关位置写 padding_idx=1; 二分类可以用 1 个或 2 个输出神经元, 损失函数要对应.

思路: 形状一路是 (B, T) → 嵌入 (B, T, E) → BiLSTM (B, T, 2R) (双向所以是 2 倍) → 对时间维求平均 (B, 2R) → 线性 + ReLU + dropout (B, H) → 线性 (B, 2). LSTM 要 batch_first=True 才和其他层的批维度一致. pack 之前长度要在 CPU 上, 不按长度排好序时加 enforce_sorted=False.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
class BiLSTM(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_size, embedding_dim, rnn_size, hidden_size, dropout):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, embedding_dim, padding_idx=1)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.lstm = nn.LSTM(embedding_dim, rnn_size, batch_first=True, bidirectional=True)
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(2 * rnn_size, hidden_size)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(hidden_size, 2)

    def forward(self, seq, lengths):
        emb = self.dropout(self.embedding(seq))                       # (B, T, E)
        packed = pack_padded_sequence(emb, lengths.cpu(), batch_first=True, enforce_sorted=False)
        out, _ = self.lstm(packed)
        out, _ = pad_packed_sequence(out, batch_first=True)           # (B, T, 2R), padding = 0
        pooled = torch.mean(out, dim=1)                               # (B, 2R)
        hidden = self.dropout(F.relu(self.fc1(pooled)))               # (B, H)
        return self.fc2(hidden)                                       # (B, 2)

pack 之后 LSTM 只在真实词元上运行, 反向的 LSTM 也从每条序列真正的最后一个词开始, 而不是从补齐的 1 开始; pad_packed_sequence 再把结果补回 (B, T, 2R), 补齐位置填 0. dropout 用在嵌入上和第一个线性层的输出上 (ReLU 之后), 最后一层输出 logits, 不加激活, 交给 CrossEntropyLoss.

易错: 按题目要求用 torch.mean(out, dim=1) 时, 分母是批里的最大长度, 补齐位置的 0 也算进去了. 我用一条长 5、一条长 2 的序列试过: 短序列的「平均」正好是真平均的 2/5 = 0.4 倍. 更准确的写法是 out.sum(dim=1) / lengths.unsqueeze(1). 这里因为分组采样器让同一批的长度接近, 误差不大, 这也正是题目先做 GroupedSampler 的好处之一.

Task 3 – Inner train loop

Task 3 - Inner train loop

      • You can also add a desc='...' to get a marking whether we currently train or evaluate
    • The function also moves the sequences and labels to device

    • If the optimizer is missing, evaluation is performed and the below described metrics are calculated
    • Values to be calculated:
      • Loss, Accuracy, both as averages of the total number of samples per epoch
      • F1 score between all predictions and labels of the epoch
def process(model, loader, criterion, optim=None):
    # TODO

翻译: 建一个全局变量 device: 有 GPU 就用 GPU, 否则用 CPU. 完成 process 函数: 接收模型、DataLoader、损失函数和可选的优化器, 遍历一次 DataLoader (一个 epoch); 用 tqdm() 包住 loader, 输出到 sys.stdout, 单位写 'batches', 可以加 desc 标明是训练还是评估; 把序列和标签搬到 device, 长度留在 CPU; 给了优化器就做反向传播训练, 没给就只评估; 都要算: 损失和准确率 (按样本数平均), 以及整个 epoch 所有预测和标签上的 F1.

思路: 损失乘以批大小累加, 最后除以总样本数 (最后一批可能不满 32, 直接平均每批的损失会有偏差). 预测和标签都收集起来, epoch 结束后一次性 f1_score(labels, preds).

答案 (先自己做再看) 
device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

def process(model, loader, criterion, optim=None):
    total_loss, correct, n = 0.0, 0, 0
    all_preds, all_labels = [], []
    desc = "train" if optim is not None else "eval"
    for seqs, labels, lengths in tqdm(loader, file=sys.stdout, unit="batches", desc=desc):
        seqs, labels = seqs.to(device), labels.to(device)            # lengths stay on CPU
        logits = model(seqs, lengths)
        loss = criterion(logits, labels)
        if optim is not None:
            optim.zero_grad()
            loss.backward()
            optim.step()
        preds = logits.argmax(dim=-1)
        total_loss += loss.item() * labels.size(0)
        correct += (preds == labels).sum().item()
        n += labels.size(0)
        all_preds += preds.tolist()
        all_labels += labels.tolist()
    return total_loss / n, correct / n, f1_score(all_labels, all_preds)

训练和评估共用一个函数, 用 optim is None 区分. model.train() / model.eval() 和 torch.no_grad() 由外面的训练循环负责 (任务 4 要求). F1 是正类 (1 = 正面) 的 F1.

易错: 参数名 optim 和模块 torch.optim as optim 同名, 函数里会遮住模块; 函数里不要再用 optim.Adam. 这是题目给定的签名, 不能改.

翻译: 给了三组配置, 先理解它们的区别. 选择合适的损失函数. 用开头给的 regularized_f1 和 save_metrics 实现超参数搜索: 遍历每组配置; 每组都重新建模型 (搬到 device) 和优化器 (Adam, 学习率用开头定义的); 每组训练 NUM_EPOCHS 轮; 在合适的时候切换 train/eval 模式; 评估时关闭梯度; 每轮训练和评估后保存指标 (看清函数需要哪些参数; csv 里只写数字, config 和 epoch 列写 1, 不写 config1、epoch1); 可以打印进度. 为了判断模型是在泛化还是「死记」, 要比较训练集和验证集上的表现: 只在模型真正泛化时保存检查点. 用给定函数算 regularized F1; 记录所有配置所有轮次中最高的验证 F1, 每当满足 regularized_f1 条件且超过此前最高值时覆盖保存参数 (最后留下的 best_model.pt 就是最好的); 记下是哪组配置; 另外在每组配置内部记录跨轮次的最高 F1, 如果连续 3 轮都低于本配置的最高值就提前停止.

思路: 三组配置的规模差很多: config1 只有 10 维 (很小, 容易欠拟合); config2 嵌入 64、LSTM 256、隐藏 32; config3 嵌入 300、LSTM 256、隐藏 256 (参数最多, 嵌入层就有 600 万). 损失用 nn.CrossEntropyLoss() (两个输出神经元). 两个计数器: 全局最好的 regularized F1 (决定存不存模型), 本配置最好的验证 F1 (决定早停).

答案 (先自己做再看) 
criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()

path = './'
logging_file = 'results.csv'

best_f1, best_config = 0.0, None
for c, (name, cfg) in enumerate(configs.items(), start=1):
    model = BiLSTM(**cfg).to(device)
    optimizer = optim.Adam(model.parameters(), lr=LEARNING_RATE)
    cfg_best, bad_epochs = -1.0, 0
    for epoch in range(1, NUM_EPOCHS + 1):
        model.train()
        tr_loss, tr_acc, tr_f1 = process(model, train_loader, criterion, optimizer)
        model.eval()
        with torch.no_grad():
            va_loss, va_acc, va_f1 = process(model, dev_loader, criterion)
        save_metrics(c, epoch, tr_loss, tr_acc, tr_f1, va_loss, va_acc, va_f1, path=path, fname=logging_file)
        reg_f1 = regularized_f1(tr_f1, va_f1)
        if reg_f1 > best_f1:                                  # generalizes and is the best so far
            best_f1, best_config = reg_f1, name
            torch.save(model.state_dict(), path + "best_model.pt")
        if va_f1 > cfg_best:
            cfg_best, bad_epochs = va_f1, 0
        else:
            bad_epochs += 1
        print(f"{name} ep{epoch:2d} train loss {tr_loss:.4f} acc {tr_acc:.4f} f1 {tr_f1:.4f} | "
              f"dev loss {va_loss:.4f} acc {va_acc:.4f} f1 {va_f1:.4f} | reg {reg_f1:.4f}")
        if bad_epochs == 3:
            print(f"early stopping {name} after epoch {epoch}")
            break
print("best:", best_config, round(best_f1, 4))

(每轮耗时: config1 约 80 秒, config2 约 30 分钟, config3 约 15–30 分钟, CPU 上.) 三组配置的表现差别很大:

  • config1 (全是 10 维) 学不起来: 训练准确率停在 53% (正好是训练集里负面评论的比例), F1 越来越接近 0, 说明它几乎总是预测「负面」; 验证准确率恒为 0.4000, 正是验证集里负面的比例. 模型太小, 学习率 1e-4 对它又太小, 4 轮后早停.
  • config2 验证 F1 在第 1 轮就到 0.709, 之后没有超过, 第 4 轮早停. 训练集上的指标还在上升, 说明还没学够, 但验证集上不再提高.
  • config3 最好: 第 3 轮验证 F1 0.7999 (同时满足 regularized_f1 条件), 存为 best_model.pt. 之后训练指标继续上升 (第 6 轮训练准确率 0.85), 验证损失却跳到 1.56、1.34, regularized F1 变成 0, 是开始过拟合的信号, 第 6 轮早停.

config3 的验证损失波动很大 (0.69 → 0.89 → 1.56), 而验证准确率只在 0.69–0.78 之间: 交叉熵对「很自信地判错」惩罚极重, 模型变得过度自信后, 少数判错样本的损失就把平均值拉高了. 我还检查了补齐的影响: 用最佳模型在验证集上评估, 按原顺序分批和按长度排序分批 (几乎不补齐) 的准确率分别是 0.7778 和 0.7779, 几乎相同, 所以这里平均池化把补齐位置算进去并没有明显损害预测.

易错: 早停计数器要用 -1 或第一轮的值初始化: 如果初始化为 0, 而某组配置第一轮的验证 F1 恰好是 0 (config1 就是这样), 第一轮就会被算成「低于最高值」, 提前一轮停下. regularized_f1 比较的训练 F1 是在训练模式下 (dropout 打开、参数边训练边变) 累计出来的, 通常比评估模式下的真实训练 F1 低, 所以「验证 F1 高于训练 F1」很容易满足; 严格的做法是训练完一轮后在训练集上再以 eval 模式评估一遍, 但那样每轮要多花一倍时间.

题目前后不一致: 正文说只在模型「验证集上的 F1 高于训练集」时才保存, 但给定的 regularized_f1 条件是「训练 F1 − 验证 F1 < 0.0015」, 也就是验证 F1 比训练 F1 低不到 0.0015 也算通过, 并不要求更高. 以函数为准. 原文笔误: 「paramaters」应为 parameters.

test (config3): loss 0.5971 acc 0.7968 f1 0.7841

测试集 (25 000 条, 正负各半) 上准确率 79.7%, F1 0.784, 和最佳轮次的验证准确率 (0.7778) 相当, 说明选出的模型泛化正常, 没有过拟合到验证集. 但绝对水平不高: 这类 BiLSTM 在 IMDB 上通常能到 85–89%, 用预训练的 Transformer (如 BERT) 能超过 93%. 主要原因是模型只训练了 3 轮就被选出来, 而且词向量从零学起.

可以改进的地方和取舍:

  • MAX_LEN = 256: 三分之一的评论被截断, 提高到 512 能看到结尾的结论, 但 LSTM 按时间步串行计算, 训练时间大约翻倍.
  • VOCAB_SIZE = 20 000: 更大的词表减少 UNK, 但嵌入层参数随之线性增长 (config3 的嵌入层已有 600 万参数), 稀有词的向量也学不好. 用预训练词向量 (如 300 维 GloVe 正好对应 config3 的 embedding_dim) 初始化, 通常能明显提高准确率并加快收敛.
  • LEARNING_RATE = 1e-4: 对 Adam 和小 LSTM 来说偏小, 1e-3 收敛快得多; 太大又会震荡, 可以配合学习率调度.
  • BATCH_SIZE = 32: 更大的批更快更稳, 但梯度噪声小, 有时泛化稍差, 也更占显存.
  • NUM_EPOCHS = 15 加早停: 早停的耐心值 3 是在「多训练几轮可能再变好」和「浪费时间、过拟合」之间的取舍.
  • 验证集的切分方式让它的类别比例 (60% 正面) 和训练集 (47% 正面) 不同, 先打乱再切分更合理.

原文笔误: 「actviate」应为 activate.

import torch.nn.functional as F

Task 1: Transformers from Scratch

In this exercise, we will build the famous 2017 Transformer Encoder-Decoder from the Paper Attention is All You Need.

翻译: 这次要从零搭建论文 Attention is All You Need (2017) 里的 Transformer 编码器-解码器. 只能用 torch、nn、F、math 等已经导入的模块.

思路: 自底向上搭: 多头注意力 → Transformer 块 (注意力 + 前馈) → 编码器 → 解码器块 → 解码器 → 整个 Transformer. 每一步先想清楚张量形状, 写完就用随机输入测一下形状.

任务 1.1: 缩放点积注意力和多头注意力
Task 1.1: Scaled Dot-Product Attention and Multi-Head Attention

Exercise 02 · Task 1.1

Task 1.1: Scaled Dot-Product Attention and Multi-Head Attention

We will start by implementing Multi-Head Attention, which concatenates multiple single scaled dot-product attention (SDPA) modules along the number of attention heads we desire. However, as concatenation implies sequential procedures, we will directly implement multi-head attention as a tensor operation on nn.Linear() layers by dividing them into num_heads subparts and calculating SDPA on each of them. By doing this, we entirely avoided sequential calculations.

In order to have trainable parameters, we can conveniently build all modules using torch's nn.Module functionality.

  • Our module's __init__() method takes in the embedding dimension emb_dim of our transformer, as well as the number of heads num_heads.
    • It stores the head_dim = emb_dim // num_heads
  • We create 4 linear layers
    • The linear layers for query, key, and value each have (emb_dim, num_heads * head_dim) size
    • The output linear layer needs to take the num_heads * head_dim as input size, and outputs the original model embedding dimension emb_dim
  • The forward() method of this module takes in query, key, value, and an optional mask, and performs the calculations of the following formula:
    • Remember that our input at this stage has dimensions (batch_size, seq_len, emb_dim)
    • We pass query, key, value through their respective linear layers
    • Then, we perform the multi-head splitting of the linearly projected outputs
      • each projection's hidden dimension has to be reshaped to fit the num_heads and head_dim structure (in that order)
      • Hint: Both batch_size and seq_len shouldn't be changed
    • Afterwards, we perform the matrix multiplication step of queries with their transposed keys, visualized by the QKT in the above formula
    • Hint: The output shape after this step should be (batch_size, num_heads, num_query_seq, num_key_seq)
    • Call this output key_out
    • After this step, add in the optional step to mask the key_out tensor. We provided this code snipped, just include it at this step in the forward pass
    • Following this, we perform the softmax step on the result of the division from key_out with the square root of our head_dim
      • Make sure to apply softmax to the correct dimension
    • Now we need just need to matrix multiply this result with the values (which were passed through their respective linear layer earlier)
    • The output shape of this operation is (batch_size, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim)
    • Reshape it to fit the input shape of our output linear layer
    • Pass it through the ouput linear layer
class MultiHeadAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, emb_dim, num_heads):
        super().__init__()

        # TODO

    def forward(self, query, key, value, mask=None):
        # TODO

        if mask is not None:
            key_out = key_out.masked_fill(mask == 0, -1e20)

        return # TODO

翻译: 多头注意力把多个缩放点积注意力 (SDPA) 沿头数拼接起来. 拼接意味着逐个计算, 所以我们直接把它写成线性层上的张量运算: 把线性层的输出切成 num_heads 份, 在每份上算 SDPA, 完全避免串行计算. __init__ 接收 emb_dim 和 num_heads, 存 head_dim = emb_dim // num_heads; 建 4 个线性层: Q、K、V 各是 (emb_dim, num_heads * head_dim), 输出层从 num_heads * head_dim 映射回 emb_dim. forward 接收 query、key、value 和可选的 mask, 输入形状 (batch_size, seq_len, emb_dim): 先各自过线性层; 再把隐藏维拆成 num_heads 和 head_dim (按这个顺序), 批大小和序列长度不变; 然后 Q 乘以 K 的转置, 得到形状 (batch_size, num_heads, num_query_seq, num_key_seq) 的 key_out; 接着插入给定的掩码代码; 再把 key_out 除以 head_dim​ 后做 softmax (注意维度); 用结果乘 V; 再变形成输出层需要的形状, 过输出层.

思路: view(b, len, heads, head_dim) 之后要 transpose(1, 2) 把头数换到第 1 维, 才能让 @ 在最后两维上做 (len × head_dim) 的矩阵乘法. softmax 在最后一维 (对每个查询, 在所有键上归一化). 合并时先 transpose 回来, 再 reshape (transpose 后内存不连续, view 会报错).

答案 (先自己做再看) 
class MultiHeadAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, emb_dim, num_heads):
        super().__init__()
        self.emb_dim = emb_dim
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.head_dim = emb_dim // num_heads
        self.query = nn.Linear(emb_dim, num_heads * self.head_dim)
        self.key = nn.Linear(emb_dim, num_heads * self.head_dim)
        self.value = nn.Linear(emb_dim, num_heads * self.head_dim)
        self.out = nn.Linear(num_heads * self.head_dim, emb_dim)

    def forward(self, query, key, value, mask=None):
        b, q_len, k_len = query.shape[0], query.shape[1], key.shape[1]
        # (b, len, emb) -> (b, len, heads, head_dim) -> (b, heads, len, head_dim)
        q = self.query(query).view(b, q_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        k = self.key(key).view(b, k_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        v = self.value(value).view(b, k_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)

        key_out = q @ k.transpose(-2, -1)          # (b, heads, q_len, k_len)

        if mask is not None:
            key_out = key_out.masked_fill(mask == 0, -1e20)

        attention = torch.softmax(key_out / math.sqrt(self.head_dim), dim=-1)
        out = attention @ v                         # (b, heads, q_len, head_dim)
        out = out.transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, q_len, self.num_heads * self.head_dim)
        return self.out(out)
mha = MultiHeadAttention(16, 4); x = torch.randn(2, 5, 16)
print("head_dim:", mha.head_dim, "out:", mha(x, x, x).shape)
head_dim: 4 out: torch.Size([2, 5, 16])

四个形状: Q/K/V 拆头后是 (b, h, len, dh); key_out 是 (b, h, q_len, k_len), 每个头一张注意力分数矩阵; 乘 V 后回到 (b, h, q_len, dh); 合并头后是 (b, q_len, h·dh). 掩码的形状 (b, 1, 1, k_len) 或 (b, 1, q_len, k_len) 通过广播作用到所有头上. 先掩码再除以 dh​​ 没关系: −1020 除以一个小数仍然极小, softmax 后是 0.

易错: 直接 view(b, heads, len, head_dim) 而不先拆再转置, 形状对但内容错 (把不同位置的数据混进了同一个头), 形状测试查不出来. Q 和 K/V 的长度可以不同 (交叉注意力里 Q 来自解码器, K/V 来自编码器), 所以拆头时要分别用 q_len 和 k_len.

题目错误: 原文说「乘 V 之后的形状是 (batch_size, seq_len, num_heads, head_dim)」. 按前面的要求 (key_out 是 (b, heads, q_len, k_len)), 乘 V 得到的是 (batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim), 头数在第 1 维; 要先 transpose(1, 2) 才是原文写的形状, 然后才能 reshape. 原文笔误: 「Now we need just need」多了一个 need; 「code snipped」应为 snippet; 「ouput」应为 output.

任务 1.2: Transformer 块
Task 1.2: Transformer Blocks

Exercise 02 · Task 1.2

Task 1.2: Transformer Blocks

We will now create Transformer Blocks out of our MultiHeadAttention module, combined with Feedforward-Networks.

  • To create the blocks, our module takes as input in it's __init__ method:
    • the embedding dimension emb_dim, the number of heads num_heads, a dropout rate dropout, and the dimension of the hidden layer in the feedforward network, often called forward_dim
    • in the __init__ method, we further need two nn.Layernorm objects with an epsilon parameter eps=1e-6
    • then, still in the __init__ method, we set up the feedforward network
    • we build it by creating an nn.Sequential module and filling it with:
      • a linear layer projecting the input onto the forward_dim
      • running it through nn.ReLU
      • and projecting the forward_dim back to the embedding dimension with another linear layer
  • the forward() method takes query, key, value and the mask
    • first, we run query, key, value, and the mask through multi-head attention
    • secondly, we build a skip-connection by adding the query back to the output of multi-head attention
      • dropout is applied to the sum, followed by our first layer norm
    • third, the output is put through our FFN
    • fourth, we build another skip-connection by adding the input of the FFN onto the output of the FFN
    • apply dropout to the result of the skip-connection, apply normalization on the dropped-out result, and return it
class TransformerBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, emb_dim, num_heads, dropout, forward_dim):
        super().__init__()

        # TODO

    def forward(self, query, key, value, mask):
        # TODO

        return # TODO

翻译: 用多头注意力加前馈网络组成 Transformer 块. __init__ 接收 emb_dim、num_heads、dropout 和前馈隐藏层维度 forward_dim; 还要两个 nn.LayerNorm, eps=1e-6; 前馈网络用 nn.Sequential: 线性层映射到 forward_dim, ReLU, 再线性层映射回 emb_dim. forward 接收 query、key、value 和 mask: ① 过多头注意力; ② 残差连接: 把 query 加回注意力输出, 对和做 dropout, 再过第一个 LayerNorm; ③ 过前馈网络; ④ 再一个残差连接, 把前馈网络的输入加到输出上; 对结果做 dropout、LayerNorm, 返回.

思路: 这是论文的 Post-LN 结构 (先加残差、后归一化). 残差加的是 query: 在交叉注意力里 query 来自解码器, 输出的长度也是 query 的长度.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
class TransformerBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, emb_dim, num_heads, dropout, forward_dim):
        super().__init__()
        self.attention = MultiHeadAttention(emb_dim, num_heads)
        self.norm1 = nn.LayerNorm(emb_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.norm2 = nn.LayerNorm(emb_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Linear(emb_dim, forward_dim),
            nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Linear(forward_dim, emb_dim),
        )
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, query, key, value, mask):
        attn = self.attention(query, key, value, mask)
        x = self.norm1(self.dropout(attn + query))
        out = self.norm2(self.dropout(self.ffn(x) + x))
        return out

一个 dropout 模块可以用两次 (它没有参数). 前馈网络对每个位置独立作用, 先升维到 forward_dim (论文里 2048 = 4 × 512) 再降回来.

题目与论文不同: 题目要求「对和做 dropout」, 即 LayerNorm(Dropout(x + Sublayer(x))). 论文 (Vaswani et al. 2017, 5.4 节) 是 LayerNorm(x + Dropout(Sublayer(x))): dropout 只作用在子层输出上, 残差那一路 x 不被丢弃. 按题目写也能训练 (练习里默认 dropout=0.0, 两者完全相同), 但 dropout > 0 时题目的写法会随机丢掉残差路径本身. 原文笔误: 「nn.Layernorm」应为 nn.LayerNorm (照抄会 AttributeError); 「it's __init__」应为 its.

任务 1.3: 编码器
Task 1.3 Encoder

Exercise 02 · Task 1.3

This already convenes the encoder side of the transformer. We now just need to incorporate it into an appropriate format so that it can take input sequences, move them to the GPU, etc. To achieve this, we create another module called Encoder.

Task 1.3 Encoder

  • The Encoder takes as input in its __init__ method:
    • the (source) vocabulary size vocab_size, embedding dimension emb_dim, number of layers num_layers, number of heads num_heads, feedforward-dimension forward_dim, the dropout rate dropout, and the maximum sequence length max_len
    • Note that the preprocessing, in this case the truncation of sequences to the maximum allowed length, is handled in the data loading process that we performed in the first exercise while loading the sequences. Here, we define the model architecture that (usually) dictates the necessary preprocessing steps.
    • We then define
      • the token level embeddings with dimensions vocab_size x emb_dim
      • positional encodings with the sinusoidal approach (function is given below)
        • You need to create an additional nn.Embedding layer and load in the sinusoid table with the .from_pretrained method
        • Freeze these embeddings
      • a dropout layer
      • and, lastly, instantiate num_layers many TransformerBlock modules inside an nn.ModuleList
  • In the forward() method, we take in the batched sequence inputs, as well as a mask
    • Then, we create the input to the positional encodings by defining a matrix which represents the index of each token in the sequence
      • Move the positions to the device on which the batched sequences are located
      • Make sure to shift each index by +1 (and the max_len in the creation of the sinusoidal table, too)
      • This is done because index 0 is usually reserved for special tokens like [PAD], which don't need a positional encoding.
    • We then run our input through the embeddings, the above create positions are run through the positional encodings, and both results are summed up
    • Apply dropout to the summed up result
    • This will be our query, key, and value input that runs num_layers times through our encoder module list
    • Return the last output
def get_sinusoid_table(max_len, emb_dim):
    def get_angle(pos, i, emb_dim):
        return pos / 10000 ** ((2 * (i // 2)) / emb_dim)

    sinusoid_table = torch.zeros(max_len, emb_dim)
    for pos in range(max_len):
        for i in range(emb_dim):
            if i % 2 == 0:
                sinusoid_table[pos, i] = math.sin(get_angle(pos, i, emb_dim))
            else:
                sinusoid_table[pos, i] = math.cos(get_angle(pos, i, emb_dim))
    return sinusoid_table
class Encoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size,
        emb_dim,
        num_layers,
        num_heads,
        forward_dim,
        dropout,
        max_len,
    ):
        super().__init__()

        # TODO

    def forward(self, x, mask):
        # TODO

        return # TODO

翻译: 这样就有了编码器的核心, 还要包装成能接收输入序列、能放到 GPU 上的形式, 即 Encoder 模块. __init__ 接收 (源语言) 词表大小、嵌入维度、层数、头数、前馈维度、dropout 率和最大序列长度 (截断在数据加载时已经做了; 这里定义的结构通常决定需要怎样预处理). 定义: 词元嵌入 vocab_size × emb_dim; 正弦位置编码 (函数已给出): 另建一个 nn.Embedding, 用 .from_pretrained 载入正弦表, 并冻结; 一个 dropout 层; nn.ModuleList 里放 num_layers 个 TransformerBlock. forward 接收批序列和掩码: 构造每个词元在序列中的位置下标矩阵, 放到输入所在的设备上, 每个下标加 1 (建正弦表时 max_len 也要加 1), 因为下标 0 通常留给 [PAD] 之类不需要位置编码的特殊词元; 输入过词嵌入, 位置过位置编码, 两者相加, 做 dropout; 这就是第一层的 query、key、value, 依次通过 num_layers 层; 返回最后的输出.

思路: torch.arange(1, seq_len + 1).expand(batch, seq_len); nn.Embedding.from_pretrained(table, freeze=True). 自注意力里 Q = K = V = 上一层的输出.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
class Encoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_size, emb_dim, num_layers, num_heads, forward_dim, dropout, max_len):
        super().__init__()
        self.tok_emb = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, emb_dim)
        self.pos_emb = nn.Embedding.from_pretrained(get_sinusoid_table(max_len + 1, emb_dim), freeze=True)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [TransformerBlock(emb_dim, num_heads, dropout, forward_dim) for _ in range(num_layers)]
        )

    def forward(self, x, mask):
        batch_size, seq_len = x.shape
        positions = torch.arange(1, seq_len + 1, device=x.device).expand(batch_size, seq_len)
        out = self.dropout(self.tok_emb(x) + self.pos_emb(positions))
        for layer in self.layers:
            out = layer(out, out, out, mask)
        return out

正弦表有 max_len + 1 行, 位置 1 … max_len 都有对应行, 第 0 行不用. 冻结后位置编码不参与训练 (论文里的正弦编码本来就是固定的).

易错: 如果建表时用 max_len 而位置从 1 开始, 长度正好等于 max_len 的序列会越界 (IndexError). torch.arange 默认建在 CPU 上, 一定要传 device=x.device, 否则 GPU 上运行时报设备不一致.

题目漏洞: 「下标 0 留给 [PAD], 所以位置加 1」并不能让 PAD 词元得不到位置编码: 位置下标只和词元在序列中的位置有关, 与它是不是 PAD 无关, 补齐的 PAD 照样得到位置 k 的编码. 真正让 PAD 不起作用的是注意力掩码. 原文用词: 「convenes」应为 constitutes (构成).

任务 1.4: 解码器块
Task 1.4: Decoder Blocks

Exercise 02 · Task 1.4

Task 1.4: Decoder Blocks

Now to the decoder part!

A DecoderBlock looks very similar to our previous TransformerBlock, but slightly extends the functionality because at its second stage, it receives inputs from both the encoder and its first stage (look closely at the input arrows in the picture!)

  • To build one, the module's __init__ method takes as input:
    • the embedding dimension emb_dim, number of heads num_heads, a feedforward dimension forward_dim, and a dropout rate
    • It then initializes:
      • an nn.LayerNorm with eps=1e-6, the MultiHeadAttention module, a TransformerBlock, and the dropout rate
  • The decoder block's forward() method takes:
    • the batched sequence input, value, key, a source mask, and a target mask
    • First, we compute self-attention representations of the input (i.e., the input serves as query, key, and value), and takes the target mask for the mask parameter
      • This is the input that is symbolized by the arrow coming from the bottom of the image
    • Secondly, we use a skip-connection by summing up the above self-attention result with the original input (again, apply dropout here and normalize the result)
      • This output is our new query
    • We now run this above created query as the query-input through a TransformerBlock, where the value and key arguments for the TransformerBlock come from the Encoder output
      • This is called cross-attention
      • Include the source mask as the mask argument in the TransformerBlock
      • return the output of the TransformerBlock

    def __init__(self, emb_dim, num_heads, forward_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__()

        # TODO

    def forward(self, x, value, key, src_mask, tgt_mask):
        # TODO

        return # TODO

翻译: 解码器块和 TransformerBlock 很像, 只是第二阶段同时接收编码器的输出和第一阶段的输出 (注意图里的输入箭头). __init__ 接收 emb_dim、num_heads、forward_dim、dropout, 初始化一个 LayerNorm (eps=1e-6)、一个 MultiHeadAttention、一个 TransformerBlock 和 dropout. forward 接收批输入、value、key、源掩码和目标掩码: ① 对输入做自注意力 (输入同时当 query、key、value), 掩码用目标掩码 (图中从下方进来的箭头); ② 残差: 自注意力结果加原输入, dropout, 归一化, 得到新的 query; ③ 把这个 query 和来自编码器输出的 value、key 一起送进 TransformerBlock, 这就是交叉注意力, 掩码用源掩码; 返回 TransformerBlock 的输出.

思路: 解码器块 = 带因果掩码的自注意力 (+ Add & Norm) + 一个现成的 TransformerBlock (它内部就是「注意力 + Add & Norm + FFN + Add & Norm」, 正好是图上面两层).

答案 (先自己做再看) 
class DecoderBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, emb_dim, num_heads, forward_dim, dropout):
        super().__init__()
        self.norm = nn.LayerNorm(emb_dim, eps=1e-6)
        self.attention = MultiHeadAttention(emb_dim, num_heads)
        self.transformer_block = TransformerBlock(emb_dim, num_heads, dropout, forward_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)

    def forward(self, x, value, key, src_mask, tgt_mask):
        self_attn = self.attention(x, x, x, tgt_mask)
        query = self.norm(self.dropout(self_attn + x))
        return self.transformer_block(query, key, value, src_mask)

易错: forward 的参数顺序是 (x, value, key, …), 而 TransformerBlock 是 (query, key, value, …), value 和 key 的顺序相反, 传参时要对上 (这里 key 和 value 都是编码器输出, 传反了也不报错, 但写法要清楚). 交叉注意力的掩码是源掩码: 它屏蔽的是编码器那边的 PAD 位置.

任务 1.5: 解码器
Task 1.5: Decoder

Exercise 02 · Task 1.5

As we could see from the large overview of the transformer architecture, this is already most of what is happening on the decoder side. Similar to our Encoder, we now must enable the DecoderBlock to take external input and embed its own sequences. We will do this in the Decoder module below.

Task 1.5: Decoder

The Decoder's __init__ method * takes as input: * the (target) vocabulary size vocab_size, embedding dimension emb_dim, number of layers num_layers, number of heads num_heads, the hidden dimensionality forward_dim of the feedforward module, as well as the maximum sequence length max_len

* We then initialize:
    * token embeddings, a dropout layer, and `num_layers` many `DecoderBlocks` inside another `nn.ModuleList`
    * We also need positional encodings, but here we don't use sinusoidal embeddings, but instead something called *relative positional encodings*, which capture the relative position between the decoder input tokens and the output tokens at each decoding step
        * They are trainable, and are implemented by another `nn.Embedding` layer, but with dimensions `max_len x emb_dim`
    * lastly, we need a linear output layer which maps the embedding dimension back to the vocabulary size
  • The modules forward() pass then takes as input the batched sequence input, the encoder output, and a source and target mask
    • The decoder then:
      • processes the sequences through our normal embeddings
      • creates inputs to the relative positional encodings by again creating a matrix of position indices from each token in the sequence (no +1 shifting this time because we train each position relative to the current encoded sequence position output)
      • The inputs again need to be moved to the batched sequence input's device
      • runs these positions through the relative positional encodings, and sums them up with the token embeddings
        • apply dropout on the sum
      • the sum will be the input to the num_layers decoder block
      • loop through all layers by passing the previous output as input through the next layer
      • the last output will put through the linear output layer and returned
class Decoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        vocab_size,
        emb_dim,
        num_layers,
        num_heads,
        forward_dim,
        dropout,
        max_len
    ):
        super().__init__()

        # TODO

    def forward(self, x, encoder_out, src_mask, tgt_mask):
        # TODO

        return # TODO

翻译: 和编码器类似, 解码器块也要包装成能嵌入自己的序列、能接收外部输入的 Decoder. __init__ 接收 (目标语言) 词表大小、嵌入维度、层数、头数、前馈维度和最大长度; 初始化: 词元嵌入、dropout、nn.ModuleList 里的 num_layers 个 DecoderBlock; 位置编码这里不用正弦, 而用所谓的「相对位置编码」, 捕捉解码器输入词元和每一步输出词元之间的相对位置: 可训练, 用另一个 max_len × emb_dim 的 nn.Embedding 实现; 最后一个线性输出层把嵌入维映射回词表大小. forward 接收批输入、编码器输出、源掩码和目标掩码: 输入过词嵌入; 构造位置下标矩阵 (这次不加 1), 放到输入所在设备; 过位置嵌入, 和词嵌入相加, dropout; 依次通过各层解码器块 (上一层输出作下一层输入); 最后过输出线性层并返回.

思路: 和 Encoder 几乎一样, 区别是位置用 0 … L−1、位置嵌入可训练、最后多一个 nn.Linear(emb_dim, vocab_size). 返回的是 logits (不做 softmax), 交给 CrossEntropyLoss.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
class Decoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, vocab_size, emb_dim, num_layers, num_heads, forward_dim, dropout, max_len):
        super().__init__()
        self.tok_emb = nn.Embedding(vocab_size, emb_dim)
        self.pos_emb = nn.Embedding(max_len, emb_dim)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
            [DecoderBlock(emb_dim, num_heads, forward_dim, dropout) for _ in range(num_layers)]
        )
        self.fc_out = nn.Linear(emb_dim, vocab_size)

    def forward(self, x, encoder_out, src_mask, tgt_mask):
        batch_size, seq_len = x.shape
        positions = torch.arange(0, seq_len, device=x.device).expand(batch_size, seq_len)
        out = self.dropout(self.tok_emb(x) + self.pos_emb(positions))
        for layer in self.layers:
            out = layer(out, encoder_out, encoder_out, src_mask, tgt_mask)
        return self.fc_out(out)

题目错误: 这里实现的并不是「相对位置编码」. 一个用位置下标 0 … L−1 查表的可训练 nn.Embedding 是可学习的绝对位置嵌入 (BERT、GPT-2 用的就是它): 每个位置有自己固定的向量, 和其他词元在哪里无关. 相对位置编码 (Shaw et al. 2018, T5 的相对位置偏置, RoPE) 是在注意力里按两个词元的距离 i − j 加偏置或旋转, 不是在输入上加一个按位置查出的向量. 另外 __init__ 的说明漏列了 dropout 参数 (签名里有, 也用到了).

任务 1.6: 组装 Transformer
Task 1.6: Transformer

Exercise 02 · Task 1.6

Now, we just need to put everything together into one Transformer.

Task 1.6: Transformer

  • Gather all necessary arguments to initialize one Encoder and one Decoder in the __init__ method
  • Additionally, we also need to include a source and a target padding index
  • For simplicity, we provide both mask creation functions

During the forward() pass, we: * take in our batched source and target sequences * call both create_mask functions on the respective source and target sequence * encode the sequence using the initialized encoder and the source mask * input the original target sequences as input into the decoder, together with the encoder output and both masks * return the output of the decoder

That's it - you made it!

If you want to test the general functionality of your Transformer, we provide a test for you below. If the asserted shape is returned, you are on the right track.

class Transformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(
        self,
        src_vocab_size,
        tgt_vocab_size,
        src_pad_idx,
        tgt_pad_idx,
        emb_dim=512,
        num_layers=6,
        num_heads=8,
        forward_dim=2048,
        dropout=0.0,
        max_len=128,
    ):
        super().__init__()

        # TODO

    def create_src_mask(self, src):
        device = src.device
        # (batch_size, 1, 1, src_seq_len)
        src_mask = (src != self.src_pad_idx).unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2)
        return src_mask.to(device)

    def create_tgt_mask(self, tgt):
        device = tgt.device
        batch_size, tgt_len = tgt.shape
        tgt_mask = (tgt != self.tgt_pad_idx).unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2)
        tgt_mask = tgt_mask * torch.tril(torch.ones((tgt_len, tgt_len))).expand(
            batch_size, 1, tgt_len, tgt_len
        ).to(device)
        return tgt_mask

    def forward(self, src, tgt):
        # TODO

        return # TODO
# general test case
device = 'cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu'

model = Transformer(
    src_vocab_size=200,
    tgt_vocab_size=220,
    src_pad_idx=0,
    tgt_pad_idx=0,
).to(device)

# source input: batch size 4, sequence length of 75
src_in = torch.randint(0, 200, (4, 75)).to(device)

# target input: batch size 4, sequence length of 80
tgt_in = torch.randint(0, 220, (4, 80)).to(device)

# expected output shape of the model
expected_out_shape = torch.Size([4, 80, 220])

with torch.no_grad():
    out = model(src_in, tgt_in)

assert out.shape == expected_out_shape, f"wrong output shape, expected: {expected_out_shape}"

翻译: 在 __init__ 里收集参数, 各建一个 Encoder 和 Decoder; 另外存源语言和目标语言的 PAD 下标; 两个建掩码的函数已经给出. forward: 接收源序列和目标序列; 分别调用两个 create_mask; 用编码器和源掩码编码源序列; 把原始目标序列、编码器输出和两个掩码一起送进解码器; 返回解码器的输出. 最后给了一个测试: 输出形状对了就说明方向正确.

思路: 源掩码 (b, 1, 1, src_len) 屏蔽源序列的 PAD; 目标掩码是「非 PAD」和下三角矩阵 (因果掩码) 的乘积, 形状 (b, 1, tgt_len, tgt_len), 第 i 个位置只能看到 0 … i.

答案 (先自己做再看) 
class Transformer(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, src_vocab_size, tgt_vocab_size, src_pad_idx, tgt_pad_idx,
                 emb_dim=512, num_layers=6, num_heads=8, forward_dim=2048, dropout=0.0, max_len=128):
        super().__init__()
        self.src_pad_idx = src_pad_idx
        self.tgt_pad_idx = tgt_pad_idx
        self.encoder = Encoder(src_vocab_size, emb_dim, num_layers, num_heads, forward_dim, dropout, max_len)
        self.decoder = Decoder(tgt_vocab_size, emb_dim, num_layers, num_heads, forward_dim, dropout, max_len)

    # create_src_mask / create_tgt_mask: given

    def forward(self, src, tgt):
        src_mask = self.create_src_mask(src)
        tgt_mask = self.create_tgt_mask(tgt)
        encoder_out = self.encoder(src, src_mask)
        return self.decoder(tgt, encoder_out, src_mask, tgt_mask)

运行题目给的测试 (CPU, torch.manual_seed(0)), 再加两项我自己的检查:

print("output shape:", out.shape)
print("parameters:", sum(p.numel() for p in model.parameters()))
# causality: changing target token 50 must not change outputs at earlier positions
tgt2 = tgt_in.clone(); tgt2[:, 50] = (tgt2[:, 50] + 1) % 219 + 1
with torch.no_grad():
    out2 = model(src_in, tgt2)
print("max change at positions < 50:", (out2[:, :50] - out[:, :50]).abs().max().item())
print("max change at positions >= 50:", (out2[:, 50:] - out[:, 50:]).abs().max().item())
output shape: torch.Size([4, 80, 220])
parameters: 44597980
max change at positions < 50: 0.0
max change at positions >= 50: 1.5943843126296997

断言通过, 输出是 (批 4, 目标长度 80, 目标词表 220), 每个目标位置对整个目标词表的打分. 因果性检查: 改动第 50 个目标词元, 前 50 个位置的输出完全不变 (差为 0.0), 后面的位置变了, 说明目标掩码生效, 解码器看不到「未来」. 参数约 4460 万, 接近论文 base 模型 (6 层、512 维; 论文共享嵌入且词表 37 000, 约 6500 万).

形状测试只能说明形状对. 为了确认模型真的能学, 我用一个小配置 (2 层、64 维、4 头) 训练「把源序列倒过来」的任务 (词表 20, 长度 8, 1500 步, Adam 1e-3, 自回归贪心解码):

step  300  loss 0.3122
step  600  loss 0.1230
step  900  loss 0.0609
step 1200  loss 0.0282
step 1500  loss 0.0618
exact-match accuracy: 1.0
src : [3, 18, 14, 18, 9, 5, 16, 4]
pred: [4, 16, 5, 9, 18, 14, 18, 3]

200 条新序列全部倒序正确. 倒序任务必须用到交叉注意力 (第 i 个输出要看源序列的第 8−i 个词), 所以这也验证了编码器-解码器之间的连接是对的.

易错: 训练时解码器的输入是目标序列右移一位 (开头加 BOS, 去掉最后一个), 标签是原目标序列; 题目的 forward 只负责「给什么算什么」, 右移要在训练循环里做. 测试里 torch.randint(0, 200, …) 会生成 0, 而 0 正是 PAD 下标, 所以测试输入里随机夹着一些被掩掉的位置, 这不影响形状.

练习 5: 深度学习中的调试
Debugging in Deep Learning源文件 slides-04-debugging.pdf (7 页)、week-4-debugging.ipynb

常用调试手段与常见错误来源
Common Debugging Techniques · Common Sources of Errors

Debugging · Slide 2–3
  • Error Messages: How to read and interpret stack traces in Python, TensorFlow, or PyTorch.
    • e.g., a RuntimeError: size mismatch in PyTorch. Trace back through the error stack to find where the dimension mismatch occurs.
  • Logging and Visualization: Using tools like print, logging libraries, or visualization frameworks (e.g., TensorBoard, Matplotlib).
    • Use print() or logging to inspect the shape of tensors at various stages of the model.
    • Use TensorBoard to plot training loss and identify anomalies, such as sudden spikes or stagnation.

Common sources of errors in deep learning workflows:

  • Data preprocessing
  • Model architecture
  • Training
  • Evaluation

Example: A model runs without errors but fails to converge. Debugging requires identifying whether the issue lies in the data pipeline, loss function, or training process.

翻译: 常用调试手段: ① 读懂报错信息: 学会解读 Python、TensorFlow、PyTorch 的调用栈 (stack trace), 比如 PyTorch 报「size mismatch」时, 顺着调用栈往回找, 定位维度不匹配发生在哪一行. ② 日志和可视化: 用 print、logging 库或可视化工具 (TensorBoard、Matplotlib); 用 print 或 logging 查看张量在模型各阶段的形状; 用 TensorBoard 画训练损失, 找出突然的尖峰或停滞. 深度学习流程里的错误通常来自四处: 数据预处理、模型结构、训练、评估. 例子: 模型运行不报错但不收敛, 要判断问题出在数据管道、损失函数还是训练过程.

最难查的错误: 最难查的是不报错的错误 (静默错误): 形状碰巧对得上但语义错了, 例如 Exercise 02 里拆多头时 view 的顺序写错. 报错的错误反而好办.

数据、模型、训练和 Hugging Face 模型的调试
Debugging Data / Model / Training Issues · Debugging on HuggingFace Models

Debugging · Slide 4–7

Debugging Data Issues

  • Checking for data corruption, missing values, and inconsistencies.
  • Verifying data preprocessing steps (e.g., tokenization, padding).
  • Inspecting datasets for bias or leakage (contamination).

Example: Handle missing values: Use pandas to check for NaN values in your dataset (df.isnull().sum()).

Debugging Model Issues

  • Identifying and fixing architectural errors (e.g., mismatched layer dimensions).
  • Ensuring appropriate activation functions and initializations.

Debugging Training Issues

  • Overfitting/Underfitting: Diagnosing these problems and applying fixes such as regularization, data augmentation, or early stopping.
    • A language model gives near-perfect results on the training set but fails on the validation set. Introduce dropout layers or regularization techniques like weight decay.
  • Learning Rate: How to detect issues and adjust learning rate schedules (using a learning rate scheduler?).
    • A model converges slowly. Adjust the rate and visualize its impact.
  • Loss Function: Debugging loss computation (e.g., incorrect target or loss function selection).
    • The loss function doesn’t mask out some (e.g., padding) tokens, causing unnecessary penalties in training: use a masked loss function.

Debugging on HuggingFace Models

  • Ensuring the correct model is being used (e.g., vanilla pretrained model / instruction-tuned version,).
  • Debugging tokenization and text preprocessing steps (make sure the tokenization/text preprocessing is done in an intended way)

翻译: 数据问题: 检查数据损坏、缺失值和不一致; 核对预处理步骤 (分词、补齐); 检查数据集里的偏差和泄漏 (测试数据混进训练数据, 即「污染」). 例: 用 pandas 的 df.isnull().sum() 查 NaN. 模型问题: 找出并修正结构错误 (层的维度不匹配); 确认激活函数和初始化合适. 训练问题: 过拟合/欠拟合: 诊断后用正则化、数据增强、早停来修; 例: 语言模型在训练集上近乎完美、验证集上很差, 就加 dropout 或 weight decay 之类的正则化. 学习率: 发现问题并调整学习率计划 (用学习率调度器); 例: 收敛太慢, 就调学习率并画图看效果. 损失函数: 检查损失的计算 (目标错了、损失函数选错了); 例: 没有把补齐的词元从损失里掩掉, 训练时会受到不必要的惩罚, 要用带掩码的损失. Hugging Face 模型: 确认用的是对的模型 (原始预训练版还是指令微调版); 确认分词和文本预处理按预期进行.

例子: 带掩码的损失最简单的写法是 nn.CrossEntropyLoss(ignore_index=PAD_ID); Hugging Face 的 Seq2SeqTrainer 把标签里的补齐位置设成 −100, 正是利用了 CrossEntropyLoss 默认的 ignore_index=-100 (Exercise 03 第 2 部分).
